FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF CHEMISTRY
&
CENTRE OF ADVANCED STUDIES IN CHEMISTRY
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH – 160 014
ADVERTISEMENT
Applications are invited from suitable candidates for the post of Project Research Scientist-I (non-
medical) in the ICMR-Adhoc research project under the joint supervision of Dr. Deepak B. Salunke,
Assistant Professor, Department of Chemistry and Prof. Sukhbir Kaur, Department of Zoology, Panjab
University, Chandigarh.
Essential Qualification:
Post Graduate Degree in Chemistry (M.Sc., preferably in Organic Chemistry) including the integrated
PG degree with PhD.
Preference will be given to the candidates with industrial research experience.
Fellowship:
Monthly emoluments of the fellowship shall be as per the ICMR norms; the duration of the fellowship
is for the period of one year and can be extended further based on the performance of the candidate.
Selection process:
Eligible and shortlisted candidates will be called for interview (offline/online) in the office of the
Chairperson, Department of Chemistry, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Applications along with Curriculum Vitae may be submitted to the office of the undersigned by email
or sent by post latest by November 22, 2023. The date and time of the interview will be informed to
the shortlisted candidates by email. No separate interview letters will be issued and no TA/DA will be
provided for attending the interview. The position is purely on temporary basis and is coterminous with
the project.
Dr. Deepak B. Salunke
Assistant Professor
Department of Chemistry
Panjab University, Chandigarh-160014
salunke@pu.ac.in
